title: CONVERT ( 5E18, INTEGER ) + CONVERT ( 5E18, INTEGER ) is -8446744073709551616: no error, the sum wraps
query: EVALUATE ROW ( "r", CONVERT ( 5E18, INTEGER ) + CONVERT ( 5E18, INTEGER ) )

source.quote: there is an overflow condition, but there is no overflow error and the result is the least significant representable digits
source.supports: integer sum, subtraction and multiplication wrap around on overflow instead of failing

source.quote: the outcome of the expression is a negative number
source.supports: the page gives this expression's result as -8,446,744,073,709,551,616
